briefing: Stocks rose broadly today: the NASDAQ gained 1.6% and the S&P 500 gained 1.3%. The portfolio is up 47.9% overall. Cash is $445.88, just under the $500 buy threshold, so we are holding all 7 positions and not forcing a small buy. Our stop-loss and profit-target rules stay in place to protect gains. NU (score 100, all five bullish signals) is first in line for the next buy once cash rises above $500.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag is the lost return from holding uninvested cash while the market goes up. We have about $446 in cash, which is only 3% of the portfolio, so the drag is small. Buying a tiny position on a moderate up day would add trading friction without adding real exposure, so it is reasonable to wait until there is enough cash for a proper position.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「現金拖累」是指市場上升時，閒置現金未能投入市場而損失的潛在回報。目前組合約有446美元現金，僅佔總值約3%，拖累有限。在溫和上升的交易日勉強建立小額倉位，只會增加交易成本，卻未能帶來實質的市場參與，因此待資金足夠建立合適倉位時才入市較為合理。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indexes rose, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ (+1.6%) beating the S&P 500 (+1.3%), which shows investors were willing to take on risk. Semiconductor and AI-infrastructure stocks such as MU, AMD, ARM, ENTG and LITE led the screen, each trading above its 20-day average with bullish MACD crossovers. No news headlines were provided today, so this explanation is based only on price and technical data, not on specific news events.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日普遍走高，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數上漲1.6%，跑贏標普500指數的1.3%，反映市場風險胃納回升。半導體及AI基建股表現領先，美光（MU）、超微（AMD）、ARM、ENTG及LITE等個股均站穩20日均線之上，MACD亦呈黃金交叉。由於今日未有新聞頭條資料，以上分析僅根據價格走勢及技術指標，並非源自特定新聞事件。
